messages:
Nora: Kicking off coordination for a joint marketplace preview: Snowflake Delta Share + Databricks Unity + Weaviate connector + Nebula HW bundle. Need a compact playbook for SI handoff and a minimal CI we can hand partners.
Jamal: Nice. Main constraints: Delta Share ACLs, Unity Catalog permissions, Nebula firmware constraints for our optimized kernels. Timeline?
Nora: Quick proposed timeline:
- Day 0: partner PM loop + logo approvals request
- Day 2: masked sample dataset uploaded to partner-test bucket
- Day 4: CI run (ingest -> transform -> upsert to Weaviate)
- Day 6: 48h soak on Nebula staging + DGX quantized path check
- Day 8: embargo lock & joint dry-run
- Day 10: publish certified-badge listing (fast path)
Priya: I'll produce the masked sample (retail demo schema) and a schema mapping doc. ETA 36h. Also adding a lightweight schema-lint step in CI.
Finn: Infra notes: Nebula nodes require firmware >= 3.4 for batching stability. If firmware mismatch we fallback to generic kernel (higher latency). I'll validate and post matrix.
Jamal: For CI, propose a GitHub Action snippet partners can copy. Priya / Finn, ok to add to repo?
Priya: Yep. Example CI we plan to include:
```
name: delta-weaviate-ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Run integration
        run: python tests/integration/run_delta_to_weaviate.py --bucket ${{ secrets.SAMPLE_BUCKET }}
```
OpsBot: Logo approval request sent to Snowflake, Databricks, Weaviate, Nebula at 2026-11-02T14:22:00Z. Status: pending.
Nora: Marketing asks for a 90s demo + 60s gif. We should avoid numeric latency claims until soak results are stable.
Finn: I'll schedule soaks on Nebula and DGX after CI green. Perf targets to capture: p50/p95/p99 at 250 qps baseline. Also memory per-shard.
Jamal: LegalBot, can you confirm EU residency/dataflow and privacy blurb for telemetry by EOD +2? We plan opt-in telemetry during soak.
LegalBot: Legal checklist created and assigned. EU residency review and telemetry privacy copy due 2026-11-04T23:59:00Z. Status: in-progress.
Priya: Decision: start with "Redwood Certified Connector" badge and recommended Nebula bundle note. Bundling triggers revenue-share/legal complexity. Recommend badge fast path.
Nora: Agreed. Finance review only if partners request combined bundle. Will ping finance later.
Finn: One gotcha: Weaviate requires consistent property names for filter queries. I'll add an adapter that normalizes Unity -> Weaviate payload keys and unit tests.
Jamal: SI handoff plan: 60m enablement webinar, quickstart repo, troubleshooting cheatsheet. @Finn you'll own runbook infra section?
Finn: Yes, will draft runbook pages: firmware checks, soak dashboard links, fallback instructions.
Nora: I'll assemble triage card with owners: infra=Finn, connector=Priya, SI=Jamal, legal=LegalBot, marketing=Nora. Add rollback: unpublish + feature-flag off + emergency support channel.
OpsBot: Action item created: "weaviate-delta-nebula-preview" assigned to Nora, due 2026-11-08T23:59:00Z.
Priya: I'll push the sample dataset and PR for CI README tonight.
Finn: Posting compatibility matrix and initial soak schedule tomorrow.
Nora: Thanks all. Quick sync Wed 10:30 PT to confirm embargo window once Legal signs off. :thumbsup: 
Jamal: End of thread.
